title: How to launch on Product Hunt: Corey Haines's playbook to #1 of the Day
summary: Corey Haines argues that hitting #1 on Product Hunt is about executing the basics, not a growth hack. Build an audience first, polish the landing page and post assets, schedule for 12:01am PT, and drive 30-100 upvotes in the first hour, then defend the spot all day.

principles.text: Getting #1 on Product Hunt is execution of the basics, not a secret hack or fancy strategy.
principles.quote: There is no secret. There is no magic growth hack. There is no silver bullet.

principles.text: Don't make Product Hunt your first marketing effort; use it to amplify an existing audience as the crescendo of your launch.
principles.quote: Instead of using Product Hunt to get your first customers, use it to reach the masses.

principles.text: Fix your landing page and onboarding before launching so the traffic actually converts into signups and customers.
principles.quote: What’s the point if you get #1 of the day, but your landing page is poorly constructed and you don't get many new signups?

principles.text: Schedule the post for 12:01am PT and promote immediately; the top positions are decided in the first hour, so aim for 30-100 upvotes then.
principles.quote: The top 5 positions are won and lost between 12:01 – 1:00am.

principles.text: Treat the PH post like a landing page: optimize thumbnail, name, tagline, video and images to convert into upvotes and site visits.
principles.quote: Think of your Product Hunt post just like you would your landing page.

principles.text: Spend the whole launch day hustling: multiple posts and emails, badges on your site, and replying to every comment, since #1 vs #2 can be a few upvotes.
principles.quote: The difference between finishing #1 and #2 can be just a few upvotes.
